description.description: What the trigger starts and why

type.description: When the trigger starts runs: cron (schedule), interval (fixed time between runs), file (new files in a folder) or http (a call to an address)

target.description: Workflow or pipeline to start, relative to the project folder

environment.description: Environment of the runs; empty: the default environment of the project

params.description: Values for the parameters of the target, by name

enabled.description: false keeps the trigger in the project without starting runs

schedule.description: cron: when to run, as minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week, e.g. 0 2 * * 1-5, or @hourly, @daily, @weekly, @monthly

timezone.description: cron: time zone of the schedule, e.g. Europe/Berlin; empty: the time zone of the computer

overlap.description: cron, interval, file: what happens while the previous run still runs: skip it or allow another run

every.description: interval: time between two runs, e.g. 15m

path.description: file: folder to watch, relative to the project folder or absolute (also UNC); http: path of the address with placeholders, e.g. /api/customers/{id}

pattern.description: file: names of the files, e.g. *.csv; upper and lower case are ignored

interval.description: file: time between two looks into the folder

param.description: file: parameter of the target that gets the path of the file (each) or the paths as a JSON list (batch)

mode.description: file: one run per new file (each) or one run for all new files of a look (batch)

existing.description: file: what happens to files already in the folder when the server starts: process them or ignore them

method.description: http: HTTP method of the calls (required for http)

auth.description: http: none, or a token the caller sends as Authorization: Bearer, e.g. { token: ${env:IMPORT_TOKEN} }

response.description: http: answer at once with 202 and the run id (accepted), or wait for the answer of the run (run)

maxConcurrent.description: http: most runs of this trigger at the same time; 0: no own limit

timeout.description: http with response: run: how long the caller waits for the answer

history.description: http: which ended runs are kept in the list of runs: all, errors or none; empty: all, with response: run only errors
